Caline Caline DCP Dual Effects series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Caline DCP-08 Nightwolf - Overdrive/Fuzz Published on February 5, 2023 Caline DCP Dual Effects series fuzz overdrive pedal Information Caline Combination of Caline CP-46 Fuzzy Bear and CP-12 Pure Sky Overdrive CP-46 Fuzzy Bear A smooth, vintage fuzz sound CP-12 Pure Sky Overdrive The Pure Sky has a great high end with plenty of transparency. It can either be used as a overdrive or can be used in more of an EQ role being always on and used to shape your tone. The 4 knobs allows massive versatility in your sound. You can cut or boost with surprising precision. In terms of build quality the Pure Sky really impresses. Despite its incredibly low cost the pedal is durably built in a sturdy metal enclosure. It also has True Bypass design, with aluminum alloy casing and a durable feeling foot switch.
